guide.relicweave.mob.fracture_wisp: It telegraphs each dash with a light trail; sidestep early, then strike while it recovers.
guide.relicweave.mob.nullwing: It screeches before diving; dodge sideways, then hit it as it climbs. It lands if it cannot dive.
guide.relicweave.mob.eclipse_moth: Harmless. In Resonance and Convergence it hovers near rifts, null wards and gravity anchors.
guide.relicweave.mob.concordance_guardia: Step out of the ring after its wind-up and leave the fixed rune beam line; it speeds up below 30%.
guide.relicweave.mob.sealed_custodian: Back off while its blue dome is up; strike after it ends. Its chests stay sealed until it falls.
guide.relicweave.mob.rune_warden: Stay beyond 4 blocks to leave it asleep. Dodge the ring burst and sidestep the three-shard volley.
guide.relicweave.mob.cycle_herald: Leave its lance line before the beam fires. It fades when Convergence ends; no loot if it vanishes.
